name: Pipeline Sentinel
desc: Validate CSV data before downstream systems depend on it.
detail: Validation runs, issue reporting and quarantined rows in a persistent audit trail. Published demo.
caption: Live dashboard · CSV validation
featureDescription: A data quality platform that checks CSV files before they reach downstream systems. Upload a batch, inspect validation issues and review quarantined rows, with a persistent history of every run.

name: LiveQuiz
desc: AI-generated trivia. Shared rooms. A live race to the leaderboard.
detail: Multiplayer trivia with AI questions, DynamoDB and WebSocket updates. Published web demo.
caption: Live application · Multiplayer trivia
featureDescription: A multiplayer trivia experience that turns a topic into AI-generated questions. Create a room, share its code and play together, with answers and scores updated in real time.

name: DeskPilot
desc: A voice assistant for the things you do every day on Windows.
detail: Voice commands, local tools, media controls, notes and reminders. Desktop demo; public installer release still has pending checks.
caption: Voice workflow · Concept illustration
featureDescription: A voice assistant for everyday work on Windows. Open applications, control music, save notes and set reminders through spoken commands, with local tools and optional AI assistance.

name: IEEE SciVis
desc: Explore alloy compositions through linked, interactive visualizations.
detail: Scientific visualization with PCA and linked views. Academic project; an active deployment was not confirmed.
caption: Project screenshot · Scientific visualization
featureDescription: An interactive workspace for exploring alloy compositions. Linked views, principal component analysis and parallel coordinates help reveal patterns across a complex scientific dataset.

name: Movie Watchlist
desc: Keep your next watch, personal ratings and movie notes in one place.
detail: A browser-based movie tracker with search and local storage. Web deployment available.

name: SnakeDocs
desc: Learn Python through 32 lessons, quick checks and saved progress.
detail: An interactive learning guide covering Python fundamentals, data structures and interview patterns.

name: CloudMetrics
desc: An AWS dashboard connecting serverless APIs and operational metrics.
detail: Lambda, API Gateway, CloudWatch and S3. System metrics include simulated demo values.

name: RAG National Parks
desc: Ask about national parks with answers grounded in retrieved documents.
detail: Retrieval-augmented generation over park information using embeddings, Chroma and an LLM.

name: RAG Document Assistant
desc: Turn PDF and text documents into a searchable knowledge source.
detail: Document ingestion and semantic retrieval with a Streamlit interface and FastAPI backend.

name: AI Resume Analyzer
desc: Compare résumé skills and identify keyword matches and gaps.
detail: React and FastAPI application. Current scoring uses rules and keyword matching rather than an LLM.

name: Movie Recommender
desc: Find your next movie through content-based similarity.
detail: A recommendation pipeline with cosine similarity, TMDB data and a Streamlit interface.

name: SoccerHub NL2SQL
desc: Ask football questions in natural language. Query structured data.
detail: An academic NL-to-SQL project with model comparisons, expected answers and evaluation results.

name: FitFindr
desc: Find clothing by size, budget and preferences, then build an outfit.
detail: Course project with example listings, query parsing, outfit suggestions and fit cards.

name: Provenance Guard
desc: Explore text attribution with recorded decisions and an appeal flow.
detail: Experimental academic API combining LLM signals and stylometric heuristics. Not a validated authorship detector.

name: AnyTongue / AnyLang
desc: A multilingual chat backend with translation and real-time messaging.
detail: Backend scope: JWT authentication, Socket.io messaging, translation and encrypted storage. No public frontend was confirmed.

name: IncidentPilot
desc: Classify Slack alerts and coordinate incident escalation.
detail: Prototype using keyword rules and sample incident history, with an MCP escalation flow.

name: Coding Projects
desc: Small Python programs built around logic, input and interaction.
detail: A collection of console projects: calculator, adventure, quiz, number guessing and rock-paper-scissors.
